assumptions: Aligned calibrated optical-Z RGBD and depth-epoch base transform.
Detected bin rests on this stock table; floor is 10 mm above bin bottom.
Stock 1.4 x 0.8 x 0.04 m top and four 0.07 m corner legs.
Hidden CAD edges/legs are inferred from the visible perpendicular edges.
Pixel/edge angular bounds are engineering allowances, not calibration proof.
Caller reprojects for base motion and invalidates registration after scene impact.

contacts.scope: Observed delivered pair-inventory episodes by topic, not scored collisions or physical contact onset/separation. The two topics can report the same contact and are never summed as a physical count. Empty inventory is not proof of separation.

physical.lean_scope: Terminal-only model poses. Bin/base displacement is relative to the first terminal sample; opening brackets, earlier motion/contact/slip, continuous clearance and penetration-free landing are unavailable.

scope: Observed run only. Exact mission contact endpoint comes from summary; observer status times are receipt times.
